content.prompt:
Write the following descriptions in set notation, utilising $\cup$ and/or $\cap$ symbols. Some can be listed, whilst others you can try.

Rational numbers greater than $\pi$.

answer.worked:
Require both rational membership and $x>\pi$:
$$\mathbb Q\cap(\pi,\infty).$$
